study: IV2b interface degradation diagnostic only, outside A/B same-weight claims
expectation: Predeclared expectation: severe3to22spatial information loss may yield left/rightACC near50%; this is a hypothesis, not guaranteed result.
interpretation: Tests fixed mapping/interface degradation, not model cross-dataset efficacy. Abovechance does not establish mapping fidelity; near-chance does not refute full22channelPRS.
mapping: fixed standard1020 inverse-square from all3 C3/Cz/C4 for missing rows, exact3direct; requires independently proved cache channel order; if unproved stop. No target score mapping choice.
report: absoluteACC/kappa,unlabelled covariance rank/conditioning,estimated bipolar magnitude and finite checks,all participants/panels; no including IV2b in generalized same-weight claims

rules.history: past only: predict trial t with original probabilities0..t-1 within block; current/future excluded
rules.batch_secondary: whole original block unlabelled probabilities,lambda=.1; same mean-square normalization
rules.binary_operation: First produce and fuse native4class outputs; select columns0/1,left/right; clip1e-12..1,normalize; ONLY THEN apply binary past-only bias. Expert-layer bias absent.
rules.reset: every native physical acquisition block, no state carried between blocks or sessions
